rationale: The candidate is a coherent rectilinear mass in all four views, so it has good geometric integrity, but it is fundamentally underdeveloped for the neighborhood-living brief. The visible form is mostly a generic box with a shallow notch and no meaningful public court, no active ground threshold, and no sectionally legible roof or terrace logic. The blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly; the response is closer to a sealed object than a street-facing building that opens toward the verified frontage. The mass also does not yet resonate with the supplied references, which all rely on clearer voids, connective circulation, terracing, or interlocking wings. Because the form is coherent in multiple views and not visibly colliding, it is not a repair failure; it is mainly a program and public-space failure.
